_comment: THE MAP (ADR 0096, docs/WORMHOLE_PROTOTYPE.md). Coordinates are metres in the map's frame, Y up; the combat plane is y = 0.
systems: where each system disc sits on the plane. highways: the systems each one joins, in order.
The highway itself runs inside the wormhole: WormholeLayout lays it out from this order at the
map's bearings, each leg the world leg times wormhole_scale clamped to wormhole_exit_min/max_seconds
of travel, two carriageways side by side, traffic on the right. planet_ramps: which systems get
ramps on which highway; a system at the end of a highway gets an on-ramp and an off-ramp, one in
the middle gets four, all shaped by the ramp rule in RoadNetwork from the exploration/ramp_* and
wormhole_* tuning keys, built once in the wormhole and placed again in open space at the planet's
mouth. mouth_height (m above the plane) and mouth_along (m from the system centre) move a highway's
planet mouths; K-112's sit higher and further out at B so its ramps pass clear of A-377B's.
ramps: interchanges, authored as waypoints between the standard exit head and merge tail; kept
for when interchanges come back to the wormhole, not built now.
Saving this file relays the map out under the ship. The gate (and the console on load) names any
bend that is too tight, any ramp that touches a road it does not join, and any highway that pitches too steeply.
